name: Apache Kafka Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 self-hosted distributed event streaming platform with durable topics, consumer groups, Kafka Connect and Streams; no vendor-imposed software message or topic quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Kafka brokers/KRaft controllers, compute, disks, networking, monitoring, security, upgrades and backups. Managed Kafka, cloud infrastructure and third-party connectors may have separate charges.
